source: Named gear is every chest or backpack the talent table marks with Found on, plus the named pieces listed on the Red Horizon page. Named weapons are the named rows already in weapons.json, plus Found-on weapons and The Drill, Cricket, Teapot, and Steamer. Fixed attributes are stored only where the page states one. Weapon type is null when the page does not name the weapon class.

gear.name: Everyday Carrier
gear.perfectText:
Using an armor kit has a 75% chance to not consume the armor kit.

Specialization armor kit bonuses are increased by 100%.

gear.name: Bober
gear.perfectText:
If you are below 30% armor, headshots from cover repair 30% of your armor.

Cooldown 1 seconds.

gear.name: The Sacrifice
gear.perfectText: All damage you deal is amplified by 30%. All damage you take is amplified by 60%,

gear.name: Robin
gear.perfectText: Weapon swapping increases total weapon damage by 28% for 5 seconds. Thus buff is lost for 5 seconds if you weapon swap while it is active.

gear.name: Chainkiller
gear.perfectText:
After killing an enemy with a headshot, your next weapon hit within 30 seconds deals an additional 150% of that killing blow's damage.
Damage is capped to 800% of your weapon damage. This is raised to 1250% if your headshot damage is greater than 150%.

gear.name: Impetus
gear.perfectText: When in combat, each skill generates a stack while active or not on cooldown. Stacks increase your total skill damage by 1.5% and total skill repair by 2%. Up to 18 stacks per skill. Lost when on cooldown.

gear.name: Equalizer
gear.perfectText: Critical hits increase total weapon damage by 1% for 5 seconds. Stacks up to 24 times.

gear.name: Sleight
gear.perfectText:
Grants +40% bonus armor while reloading.
Grants 0-30% of your armor as bonus armor to all other allies when they are reloading, based on your Armor core attributes.

gear.name: Zero F's
gear.perfectText:
When your armor is depleted, repair 100% of your armor.

Cooldown: 55 seconds

gear.name: Momma Badger
gear.perfectText: While at full armor, increases total skill repair by 160%.

gear.name: Strategic Alignment
gear.perfectText: Applying a status effect to an enemy increases total skill damage and repair by 20% for 27 seconds.

gear.name: Trick Shot
gear.perfectText: Killing an enemy adds 1 round of a random special ammo into your sidearm. Cooldown: 8s.

gear.name: Rushdown
gear.perfectText: The last enemy you have damaged with a skill is marked. Dealing weapon damage to that enemy consumes the mark to reduce active cooldowns by 12s. Cooldown: 4s.

gear.name: Melon Baller
gear.perfectText: Headshots increase total weapon damage by 20% for 1.5s. 5s with marksman rifles. Headshot kills increase total weapon damage by 15% for 10s.

gear.name: Keeper
gear.perfectText: When your shield is damaged, you gain +25% bonus armor and all other allies gain +35% of your armor as bonus armor for 3s. Cooldown: 3s.

weapons.name: Dark Winter
weapons.perfectText: Killing an enemy with a critical hit grants +90% critical hit damage for 10 seconds.

weapons.name: Baker's Dozen
weapons.perfectText: Magazine capacity is increased by 30%. Missed shots from cover have a 100% chance to return to the magazine.

weapons.name: Interchange
weapons.perfectText:
Swapping to this weapon grants +13% Rate of Fire and +12% Weapon Damage for 10s.
Swapping from this weapon grants +5% Rate of Fire and +4.5% Weapon Damage for 10s. Receiving one of the bonuses will remove the previous one if it's still active. Two instances of this Talent will not function at the same time.

weapons.name: Trader
weapons.perfectText:
Swapping to this weapon grants +13% Rate of Fire and +12% Weapon Damage for 10s.
Swapping from this weapon grants +5% Rate of Fire and +4.5% Weapon Damage for 10s. Receiving one of the bonuses will remove the previous one if it's still active. Two instances of this Talent will not function at the same time.

weapons.name: The Drill
weapons.perfectText: Killing enemies farther than 20m builds up stacks. Max stack is 2. Hitting an enemy within 20m uses all stacks to provide +35% Amplified Damage to enemies within 20m for 5s.

weapons.name: Cricket
weapons.perfectText: Killing enemies farther than 20m builds up stacks. Max stack is 2. Hitting an enemy within 20m uses all stacks to provide +35% Amplified Damage to enemies within 20m for 5s.

weapons.name: Teapot
weapons.perfectText: The first 48% of your magazine will have -100% Critical Hit Chance. The rest will have 100%.

weapons.name: Steamer
weapons.perfectText: The first 48% of your magazine will have -100% Critical Hit Chance. The rest will have 100%.

weapons.name: Brutus
weapons.perfectText: Amplifies weapon damage by +25% to enemies that are not targeting you.

weapons.name: Whisper
weapons.perfectText: Amplifies weapon damage by +25% to enemies that are not targeting you.

weapons.name: The Virginian
weapons.perfectText: Critical hits have a 75% chance to return the bullet to the magazine. If a bullet is returned to the magazine the next shot has +50% increased damage.

weapons.name: Mechanical Animal
weapons.perfectText:
Weapon kills grant +1 skill tier for 19 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times
Weapon kills at tier 6 grant overcharge for 15 seconds.

Overcharge cooldown: 90 seconds.

weapons.name: Scalpel
weapons.perfectText:
Weapon kills grant +1 skill tier for 19 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times
Weapon kills at tier 6 grant overcharge for 15 seconds.

Overcharge cooldown: 90 seconds.

weapons.name: Brain Break
weapons.perfectText: Deal 35% Amplified Damage to confused enemies. After 4 kills, applies Confuse to the enemy you hit.

weapons.name: Insult to Injury
weapons.perfectText: Deal 35% Amplified Damage to confused enemies. After 4 kills, applies Confuse to the enemy you hit.

weapons.name: Pyromaniac
weapons.perfectText:
Deal +30% weapon damage to burning enemies.
After 3 kills, applies burning to the next enemy you hit.

weapons.name: Lockdown
weapons.perfectText: Amplifies weapon damage by 25% to ensnared enemies. After 3 kills applies Ensnare to the next enemy you hit.

weapons.name: Froth
weapons.perfectText: Amplifies weapon damage by 25% to ensnared enemies. After 3 kills applies Ensnare to the next enemy you hit.

weapons.name: Gear Shift
weapons.perfectText: The top half of the magazine has 25% rate of fire and -30% weapon damage. The bottom half of the magazine has -18% rate of fire and +38% total weapon damage.

weapons.name: Glory Daze
weapons.perfectText: Receive +100% stability at the cost of -35% optimal range.

weapons.name: Manic
weapons.perfectText: Every 2 reloads from empty increases your base magazine capacity by 100%.

weapons.name: Enforcer
weapons.perfectText: 2 consecutive kills refills the magazine and grants +40% weapon damage for 10 seconds.

weapons.name: Tsunami
weapons.perfectText: 2 consecutive kills refills the magazine and grants +40% weapon damage for 10 seconds.

weapons.name: Boomstick
weapons.perfectText: Reloading grants +6% weapon damage for 10s. Stacks up to 5 times.

weapons.name: Carnage
weapons.perfectText:
Deal +35% weapon damage to bleeding enemies.

After 3 kills, applies bleed to the next enemy you hit.

weapons.name: Lightning Rod
weapons.perfectText: Killing a target has a 85% chance to refill the magazine.

weapons.name: Stage Left
weapons.perfectText: Dealing damage with a grenade applies a mark on target. Targets with mark will take 40% more damage to armor have a -30% movement speed. Mark will disappear after 10 seconds.

weapons.name: Surge
weapons.perfectText: Headshots grant +25% skill damage for 15 seconds.

weapons.name: Purist
weapons.perfectText: Increase Weapon Damage by 47% when no Skills are Deployed or on cooldown.

weapons.name: Lud
weapons.perfectText: Increase Weapon Damage by 47% when no Skills are Deployed or on cooldown.

weapons.name: Big Show
weapons.perfectText: Amplifies 35% extra damage to shocked targets. After 3 kills, applies shock to the next enemy you hit.

weapons.name: Like Glue
weapons.perfectText: Receive +3.5% Amplified Damage on the next shot with the weapon for each pellet that hits the target, if at least 4 pellets hit.

weapons.name: Thorn
weapons.perfectText: Receive +3.5% Amplified Damage on the next shot with the weapon for each pellet that hits the target, if at least 4 pellets hit.
